description: Follow a product for the user: Lowbird alerts them (app, email or Telegram, as they chose) when the price drops, or goes below `target_price` if given. Accepts an Amazon link, an ASIN or a Lowbird id; products not yet tracked are added. Nothing is deleted: if the product is already followed, only its alert threshold is updated, and the user can change it again or unfollow at any time. Use it when the user wants to be alerted when a specific product drops ("avvisami se scende"). Requires signing in.

product.description: An Amazon product link, an ASIN or a Lowbird product id.

target_price.description: Optional alert threshold in the marketplace currency, e.g. 79.90.

name: watch_product

Product.description: Un prodotto del catalogo, con i prezzi già formattati nella valuta del marketplace.

price_amount.description: Gli stessi prezzi come numeri (unità della valuta), per i grafici delle viste.

price_checked_at.description: Quando il prezzo è stato rilevato: va mostrato accanto al prezzo.

price_with_coupon.description: Prezzo con coupon o sconti al check-out, se più basso.
